The ''' Battle of Kabal''' was fought at [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the forces of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Sander Delvardus]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> After the unsuccessful [[Battle of Sullust (Delvardus campaign)|attack]] of Delvardus on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], the New Republic led by the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Sien Sovv]] launched a counterattack campaign for the control of territories of the [[Eriadu Authority]].<ref name="TEA" /> The battle was described as a "merciless assault".<ref name="TEA" />
